source.note: The archives were packed from this tree; main carries it as aca7339 on top of one later commit (d0e8b27).

publication: Fifteen new versions are live from one revision: every registry shasum matches its tested archive and every tarball downloaded with no credentials is byte-identical to it. @volter/game-editor, the largest, was reported by the registry as staged for several minutes while it processed, then went live without any approval. First publication of @volter/model-editor, @volter/editor-react and @volter/editor-xstate.

checks.packedImports: 1159 files across 8 packages (modeling); 2269 files across 15 packages (game)
checks.servedModules: served-bundle table matches the template and catalog (16 packages); runtime image carries every template and catalog dependency (33)

packedAcceptance.game: Runtime image installed from the fifteen archives with no workspace links (571 packages); create linked it and installed nothing; HeroBox opened with no story or mount failures; the game played and rendered; an Inspector edit wrote src/scenes/MainScene.tsx and undo/redo round-tripped it; prebundled chunks import three through the stable doorway; the orbit hint is absent from the bundles.
packedAcceptance.modeling: The eight archives installed with no links (435 packages, 0 vulnerabilities); cube.blend opened with no failures in the Blender look; a Blender edit moved Cube and editor undo/redo round-tripped it. Note: a read-only blender-execute also records a history step.

installation.credentials: none (env -i with a fresh HOME and npm cache)
installation.path: npx -y @volter/game-editor@0.5.66 create fresh-game installed the runtime image from the registry, linked it, downloaded the pinned game workbench anonymously and started a session; npx -y @volter/model-editor@0.5.66 create my-models did the same for the model editor.

audit: The model editor installs with 0 vulnerabilities. The game runtime image reports 8 (5 low, 3 moderate), all through colyseus -> @colyseus/auth -> grant/request-oauth (uuid, elliptic via jwk-to-pem); no upstream fix exists.
limitations: See WORK.md for the game editor's remaining list.
